title: Homelessness in the U.S. saw its largest drop in more than a decade last year
content: Homelessness declined after years of record-high levels but it still remains at nearly 700,000. The Trump administration and homeless advocacy groups cite different reasons for the drop.

title: The surprising and often forgotten history of economic populism in Texas
content: NPR's Rob Schmitz speaks with Austin-based political commentator David Griscom. He authored a book titled The Myth of Red Texas which tells the story of economic populism in Texas.

title: Israel's president taps opposition candidate, not Netanyahu, to form a government
content: Gadi Eisenkot ran as the main rival to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, but neither won enough support to command a majority. Israel's main parties have recommended Eisenkot form a new government.

title: Polish gunman who killed 6 people in Krakow has 'ultranationalistic' views, authorities say
content: A gunman targeted random people as he drove into Krakow's Main Square, a major tourist spot. Police shot and wounded the gunman during a gunfight.

title: Ousted Paraguayan president appears before prosecutors
content: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña was removed from office and placed under house arrest Friday. The Senate voted on his impeachment after the collapse of a state-affiliated bank.

title: A promising new medicine against heart disease fails unexpectedly
content: Doctors expected an experimental drug that lowers a common risk factor for heart attacks would save patients' lives. The medicine made no difference.

title: Democrats plan to widen their probes of fatal ICE shootings
content: The killings of Renee Good and Alex Pretti during the ICE surge in Minneapolis last winter was a pivotal moment for the country. After Democrats' sweeping wins this week, their deaths at the hands of immigration agents will likely be the targets of renewed investigations.

title: Perspective: Simon Winchester was here to tell a story
content: British American reporter and author Simon Winchester died of a heart attack Nov. 3. We take a moment to remember his long career, which included covering Bloody Sunday and Watergate.

title: This teen boy set out to get people talking about periods. He's now a Diana honoree
content: This year's the Princess Diana honor roll highlights 198 inspiring young activists and advocates — including an 18-year-old guy in India who founded Team Period.

title: An unexpected activist emerged to help block a $5 billion data center in Maryland
content: Thousands across the U.S. have gotten involved to oppose data centers. One is a Maryland woman who'd been evicted after a pay cut and became a leader of a community effort that blocked a vast project.
